Entry Models · Advanced

Market Maker Sell Model (MMSM)

A directional variant of the broader market-maker-model narrative, commonly described as range/accumulation and possible buy-side manipulation followed by downside delivery. Exact boundaries are discretionary.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Start with a higher-timeframe bearish draw on liquidity and a defined dealing range.
  2. Map a range and a possible buy-side manipulation without assuming it must occur.
  3. Require bearish displacement and structure confirmation before studying a short entry.
  4. Map downside opposing liquidity and define invalidation.
Use as a multi-session narrative hypothesis for chart replay, not as an entry signal in isolation.

Common mistakes and limitations

Calling every session high a Judas swing; assuming distribution will always complete; ignoring event-driven repricing.
